name: mixed-budgets
abstract_description: Give each variable its own tight budget instead of one uniform bound. Tight per-variable bounds propagate through the solver where loose uniform bounds do not.
origin_result: per-triple K budgets: CNF unchanged (1.58M clauses) but search space pruned 10^108 (2026-09-09)
applicability: Any combinatorial search with a uniformity assumption on variable budgets
